Delhi Police Officer Suspended Over Instagram Videos During BRICS Summit

A Delhi Police officer, identified as Inspector Anil Kumar, was suspended after videos of him with a sniper rifle and other firearms were posted on Instagram. The incident occurred during the security arrangements for the BRICS Summit. The videos, which showed him flaunting the weapons, sparked public debate and questions about his assignment to a sensitive security operation. The officer was reportedly part of the security detail for the summit.
